international.title: Hegseth boasts about Maduro’s capture while vowing to deepen US military cooperation with Venezuela
international.summary: The US defense secretary called the former president’s capture the ‘most sophisticated military operation’ in Latin American history Pete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”. Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999.
